summary: Main weather particle system update. Sorts drivers by distance, then either spawns wind-affected weather particles (when the enable flag is clear or the packed flag reads active) or only refreshes low-type subsystems. Computes a wind offset vector and visibility distance from the camera/session data obtained through VirtualDispatchHelper, then updates every emitter child with rotation and scaling. Called from GamePostMainLoop and StateTriggerCheck.

operations.description: SortDriversByDistance is invoked with the global at 0x8AC4E0 so weather spawn/update distance ranking is fresh.

Branch on (!byte_7C56AC || PackedFlagRead_9a00(&dword_8AB6EC)): the enable flag at 0x7C56AC clear, or the packed flag at 0x8AB6EC read as active, selects the wind-spawner path; otherwise the subsystem-only refresh path runs.
If flt_8AFEE4 > 0.0 and the spawner pointer at this+0x1C is non-null, the wind-based particle spawn is performed.
VirtualDispatchHelper(&dword_5EA510) returns a camera/session vector; compute the wind offset as (v[9]*0.25 - v[3], v[10]*0.25 - v[4], v[11]*0.25 - v[5]).
sub_4CC970 is called with the spawner pointer this+0x1C, the computed wind offset vector, and flt_8AFEE4 as arguments.
Iterate the particle subsystem array guarded by this+0x10 > 0: for each of this+0x10 subsystems, walking the array at this+0x14 in 108-byte strides, call sub_4CDB20(element, flt_8AFEE4).
Else branch: iterate the same this+0x10 subsystem array (base this+0x14, 108-byte stride) and call sub_4CDB20(element, a2) only for elements whose DWORD at +4 is <= 5.
If dword_8AB6E4 == 2, derive the emitter fade value from the scoring/session data; otherwise use the default dbl_8AFE98.
When dword_8AB6E4 == 2, VehicleDataAccessor(&dword_8AB6EC) is queried; a return of 5 resets the fade value v22 to 0.0.
Otherwise FloatDifference(&dword_8AB6EC) produces the fade value v22.
When dword_8AB6E4 != 2, the fade value v22 is taken from the double global dbl_8AFE98.

Second VirtualDispatchHelper(&dword_5EA510) call builds the camera direction vector as the negation of v[3], v[4], v[5], and computes the visibility value as max(0, 430.0 - 4.0 * length(v[9], v[10], v[11])).

Iterate the emitter children guarded by this+0x0 > 0: for each of this+0x0 children, walking the child array at this+0x4 in 60-byte strides, call ParticleEmitterChildUpdateWithRotationAndScaling(child, v22, &cameraVector, visibility).
Return the emitter child count read from this+0x0.
